definitions.X: mean 2xx completions/s in the last 20 seconds of a 30-second step
definitions.generator_limited: X(N) >= 0.9 of standalone noop ceiling G
definitions.connection_model_noticeable_lag: schedule-lag p95 >= 5% of a 30-second step; disclosed as a method limitation but not an assignment rule for excluding N from USL
definitions.cadvisor_sampling: per-pod means from range-query samples in [window start-1s, window end+11s] because cAdvisor counter refresh can yield NaN at an exact 5s timestamp
definitions.imbalance: max per-pod successful completions/s divided by pod mean
